scope: Provider-free supplemental observed input attribution; no primary retotal, new experiment, runtime mutation, or causal-share estimate.

red_regressions_observed: same output item accepted for two distinct response IDs
native boolean usage compared equal to recorded integer usage
generated message output accepted without assistant role
safe optional native input projection absent
verification.independent_review: bench_feature: arithmetic/output review and optional input-enrichment review closed; final 20 tests independently GREEN; no remaining findings
verification.complexity: linear passes in captured metadata size plus O(M log M) input-item ranking; no quadratic join
verification.real_agent_workflow: Not affected: retained metadata and captures are read offline; no provider calls, agent prompts, launch behavior, or runtime state are changed.

historical_replay.note: Full per-response/item evidence is a generated artifact; this freeze record is its compact summary and source identity.

direct.reason: no completed raw response attribution capture

work_leaf.residuals: zero in every reconciled field of every response

example.interpretation: One exact retained tool-result item is charged as input across 49 observed responses; not 49 separate file reads and not a causal allocation of savings.

method: Verify pinned helper hashes, native source hashes/thread/model scope, and original-versus-forwarded app capture provenance.
Deduplicate response IDs and reject conflicting response metadata or output-item ownership.
Sum top-level attribution.items plus request_fields only; nested content subdivisions are not summed again.
Reconcile input, cached input, output, reasoning output, and cache-write counts; retain signed residuals and unknown shapes.
Join generated output IDs to exact native thread/item identities; message outputs require assistant role.
Key repeated input charges by thread/item identity. Optional native links use exact IDs only, never prefixes, call_id similarity, or content matching.
Store safe input metadata once per item identity. Missing native links remain unlinked without invalidating otherwise exact provider arithmetic.
Retain all admitted manifest rows and failures; do not copy prompt, command-argument, or content bodies.
post_screen_use: Use the frozen whole-workflow bounds and compaction audit before interpreting mechanism evidence.
Read prompt_activity.exposures for exact site, agent, thread, turn, byte-span, and same-agent RPC links; controls use the same unchanged eligible site.
Separate per-thread work before the first target site from later work. Concurrent cross-agent effects prevent labelling every locally unexposed thread causally untouched.
Follow each exposure through the whole local directive/command-result/edit/read/done cycle. The frozen following_turn alone is not the complete cycle.
Join following_turn action item IDs to this audit's output_items and response IDs, then inspect exact input-item charges on additional continuations.
Treat +3 bytes per ACK replacement and -189 bytes per removed command cue as exact byte effects, not identified counterfactual token costs. Persistent history can carry cue text into later requests.
Use stage differences as descriptive context only; do not assign causal savings shares from cached-input arithmetic or a single exploratory screen.
